claims: The model-facing contract fixes the diagnostic at responsibility gate 1 and permits framing only. It explicitly forbids consequential recommendations or execution, durable-truth promotion and named-employee assessment, while reserving purpose, standards, exceptions and the final call to humans.

Across the care, research, manufacturing and story families at all three internal depths, the frozen boundaries assign service, quality, commercial, role, customer-accountability, investment and creative standards to accountable human roles. AI is limited to preparing analysis, tests or schedules inside human gates and rejection rights.

Every permitted answer exposes a declared select, stop, bound or reshape effect driven by the human answer. Unknown answers cannot select a route and instead preserve the consequential pause while requesting evidence, so the contract prepares the decision without committing it.

The manufacturing customer-impact question offers only human final-call owners. The profile validator rejects AI, system, model, automation or agent as a final-call option, and the frozen mutation checks exercise that rejection.

Role redesign remains separate from named-person employment judgement. The manufacturing correction, oracle boundary, forbidden claims, model task and exact authority checks prevent a frustration statement or system output from deciding who should leave.
